grader.scenario: Customer experiencing Xbox Series X Strict NAT and UPnP failure after router firmware update

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Opening 'Thank you for calling S-Net gaming and broadband technical support' and survey mentioned at [11:28].

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Hold announced ('Please bear with me for two minutes') and thanked at [04:40] without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified full address and phone number within 42 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Naturally addressed Ciaran by name throughout.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: When Ciaran had an acute frustration outburst at [06:01] over the Double NAT error message, Maya warmly validated his tournament anxiety at [06:28] and calmly explained that the router was applying firewall rules.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Restatement at [02:55]: 'So to make sure we are completely aligned, Ciaran, your Xbox Series X is connecting over Wi-Fi with a Strict NAT and failed UPnP after the recent firmware restart, and we need to reserve a static IP and enable UPnP or port forwarding on your Hub Two to get an Open NAT, is that correct?'

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent listened attentively, asked no repeated questions, and verified the IP at [05:13] before committing the DHCP reservation.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent enabled UPnP, bound the static DHCP IP, forwarded the required gaming ports, and verified all services.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Probed connection method, console model, router firmware history, and other connected devices.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Customer verified Open NAT, successful multiplayer test, and working party chat.
